description: Onboarding window (3 pages: Welcome, Permission, Try it) shown on first launch
steps: Modify Sources/Ledge/Preferences.swift - Add hasCompletedOnboarding Bool property backed by UserDefaults key 'hasCompletedOnboarding' (defaults to false, no need to register since bool returns false by default which is what we want for first launch).
Create Sources/Ledge/OnboardingWindow.swift - NSWindow (titled, closable, not resizable, ~550x450) with NSHostingController hosting OnboardingView. Has show() method. isReleasedWhenClosed = false.

Create Sources/Ledge/OnboardingView.swift - SwiftUI view with 3 pages navigated by Next/Back buttons: (1) WelcomePage - app icon, 'Welcome to Ledge', one-sentence description. (2) PermissionPage - explains Accessibility needed, button to open System Settings (using the same URL scheme from AppDelegate), live poll of AXIsProcessTrusted() with checkmark when granted. (3) TryItPage - shows TrackpadPreviewView, instruction text 'Slide along the right edge now', live step count feedback (bind to a step counter that observes GestureController.stepCount or similar). After completing page 3: sets hasCompletedOnboarding = true and closes.

Modify Sources/Ledge/AppDelegate.swift - After building controller/menuBar, check if !preferences.hasCompletedOnboarding. If so, show onboarding window. Own the OnboardingWindow instance. Pass needed references for AX polling and step detection.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding has 3 navigable pages with Next/Back
Page 2 polls AXIsProcessTrusted with live UI update
Page 3 shows trackpad preview and live step detection feedback
AppDelegate shows onboarding on first launch only
